name: The Mira Hong Kong
intro: Our Hong Kong hotel.

name: Jordan MTR Station
intro: An MTR station on Nathan Road in Kowloon, the closest stop to Eaton HK.
tips: Use Exit B2 for Eaton HK (about a 5-minute walk).
addressZh: 香港九龙 佐敦站

name: Eaton HK
intro: A design-forward hotel on Nathan Road, home to Yat Tung Heen. We're here for lunch, not to stay.
addressZh: 香港九龙弥敦道380号 香港逸东酒店

name: Yat Tung Heen
intro: A Michelin-recognised Cantonese restaurant inside Eaton HK, known for dim sum and roast meats. The main reason for the Hong Kong day trip.
tips: Reservation at 11:00 AM, on B2 of Eaton HK. Dim sum and barbecued pork (叉烧) are the classics.
address: B2, Eaton HK, 380 Nathan Road, Jordan, Kowloon
addressZh: 香港九龙弥敦道380号 香港逸东酒店B2层

name: Jordan / Nathan Road
intro: Kowloon's main avenue, lined with neon signs, shops and tea restaurants. A short walk to digest after lunch.
tips: Don't add Central or Causeway Bay; we need to head back to Shenzhen.
addressZh: 香港九龙佐敦 弥敦道

name: Crystal Hotel Shenzhen Bay MixC
intro: Our Shenzhen hotel, next to Shenzhen Bay MixC in Nanshan.

name: Nantou Ancient City
intro: A historic walled neighborhood that pre-dates modern Shenzhen by centuries. Its old lanes are now full of cafés, small shops and exhibitions. It's a nice contrast to the high-tech Shenzhen we see later in the trip.
tips: No need to tick off sights; just wander slowly on foot.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区南头古城

name: Milk Buffalo Queen Dessert Shop (Nanshan)
nameZh: 水牛奶皇后糖水铺（南山店）
intro: A Cantonese dessert shop known for buffalo-milk puddings and sweet soups (糖水). An afternoon rest and sugar stop.
tips: Try a buffalo-milk double-skin milk pudding (双皮奶). Keep it light; dinner is soon.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区 水牛奶皇后糖水铺（南山店）

name: Shekou Wu Ji Crispy Chicken & Oyster Chicken Hotpot
nameZh: 蛇口吴记·脆皮鸡·生蚝鸡煲
intro: A local Shekou restaurant known for crispy-skin chicken and oyster-and-chicken claypot. Tonight's main dinner.
tips: Order the crispy chicken (脆皮鸡) and the oyster chicken pot (生蚝鸡煲).
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区蛇口 吴记脆皮鸡生蚝鸡煲

name: Sea World (Shekou)
intro: A waterfront plaza in Shekou built around a retired cruise ship, with restaurants, bars and a light show area. Optional evening stroll if we still have energy.
tips: Low priority. Skip it if everyone's tired.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区蛇口 海上世界

name: Futian Checkpoint
intro: A land border crossing between Shenzhen and Hong Kong. It connects directly to Lok Ma Chau MTR station on the Hong Kong side.
tips: Have passports and Hong Kong/mainland entry documents ready. Allow 30–45 minutes to cross.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市福田区 福田口岸

name: Huaqiangbei
intro: Shenzhen's famous electronics district: floors of stalls selling phones, accessories, components and gadgets. It shows the city's electronics industry up close, unlike the polished brand flagships.
tips: Explore on foot. Compare prices before buying.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市福田区 华强北路

name: Huaqiang Longjiang Pork Knuckle Rice (Shenfang)
nameZh: 华强隆江猪脚饭（深纺店）
intro: A casual spot for Chaoshan-style braised pork knuckle over rice. A small snack between Huaqiangbei browsing, not a full meal.
tips: Share a portion; dinner is at Fan Lou.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市福田区华强北 华强隆江猪脚饭（深纺店）

name: Fan Lou (Huaqiangbei Flagship)
intro: A popular Cantonese restaurant known for dim sum and classic dishes in a retro Hong Kong–style setting. Tonight's dinner.
tips: Expect a wait at peak times.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市福田区华强北 繁楼（华强北总店）

name: MixC World
intro: A modern open-air shopping district in Nanshan's tech neighborhood. Home to the Xiaomi and Huawei flagship stores.
tips: Stores open at 10:00 AM.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区深南大道9668号 华润万象天地

name: Xiaomi Flagship Store (MixC World)
intro: Xiaomi's large showroom for phones, smart-home devices and its whole product ecosystem. One of the three tech brands we most wanted to see.
tips: Look for products not sold in the US, like Xiaomi's EVs and smart-home gear.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区 万象天地 小米之家旗舰店

name: Huawei Flagship Store (MixC World)
nameZh: 华为旗舰店·深圳万象天地
intro: Huawei's big flagship store: phones, wearables, laptops and smart-living products you won't see in the US.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区 万象天地 华为旗舰店

name: OCT-LOFT Creative Culture Park
intro: Former factory buildings turned into a creative district of galleries, design shops and cafés. A walk after lunch.
tips: Flexible stop: shorten or skip if the tech stores run long.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区锦绣北街2号 华侨城创意文化园

name: Runyuan Siji Coconut Chicken (OCT-LOFT)
nameZh: 润园四季椰子鸡（华侨城LOFT店）
intro: A well-known Shenzhen coconut-chicken hotpot: fresh coconut water as broth with free-range chicken. A light, very local lunch.
tips: Drink a bowl of the broth before adding meat. The lime-chili dipping sauce is key.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区华侨城创意文化园 润园四季椰子鸡（华侨城LOFT店）

name: Happy Coast
intro: A waterfront shopping and entertainment area in Nanshan, home to the DJI flagship store.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区白石路东8号 欢乐海岸

name: DJI Flagship Store
intro: Flagship of Shenzhen-born DJI, the world's leading drone maker. Hands-on demos of drones, Osmo cameras and gimbals.
tips: Of the three tech stores, give this one the most time (~1.5 hrs).
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区 欢乐海岸 大疆旗舰店

name: Shenzhen Bay MixC
intro: A large, upscale mall by Shenzhen Bay (not the same as MixC World from the morning). A stop for coffee, a rest and a restroom break.
tips: Don't eat a full dinner here; dinner is delivery at Talent Park.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区 深圳湾万象城

name: Shenzhen Talent Park
intro: A lakeside park facing the Houhai skyline, one of the best places to watch Shenzhen light up at night. A top priority: we stay from sunset through dinner and the night walk.
tips: For food delivery, set the pickup to the nearest park gate in Amap and add a note: “人才公园XX门，到后电话联系，我出来取。”
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区 深圳人才公园

name: He Ji Boji Rice Rolls
intro: A local breakfast spot for Cantonese steamed rice rolls (肠粉) made fresh on bamboo trays. Our brunch on the last Shenzhen morning.
tips: Get rice rolls with egg and beef or pork.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市南山区桂庙路68号 何记簸箕炊肠粉

name: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport
intro: Shenzhen's main airport, where we fly to Chongqing.
tips: Arrive around 2.5 hours before the flight.
addressZh: 广东省深圳市宝安区 深圳宝安国际机场

name: Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street
intro: Chongqing's downtown heart, centered on the Liberation Monument: bright lights, malls, restaurants and busy pedestrian streets. Our hotel is right here.
tips: Great for late-night noodles (小面), wontons (抄手) and pork-trotter soup (蹄花汤).
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区 解放碑步行街

name: The Westin Chongqing Liberation Square
nameZh: 重庆解放碑威斯汀酒店
intro: Our Chongqing hotel, right in the middle of Jiefangbei. Restaurants and late-night food are within walking distance.

name: Tongyuanmen City Wall Relic Park (Qixinggang)
intro: One of the surviving gates of Chongqing's old city wall, in the Qixinggang neighborhood. It's our high starting point, so the rest of the morning is downhill.
tips: Tell the taxi 通远门城墙遗址公园, not the lower entrance of the Mountain City Trail.
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区七星岗 通远门城墙遗址公园

name: Mountain City Trail
intro: A walking route through old residential lanes, stone stairs, cliffs and viewpoints. It shows why Chongqing is called the “Mountain City”.
tips: Route: Tongyuanmen → Consulate Lane → Ren'ai Hall → downhill toward Shibati.
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区 山城步道

name: Shibati Deng Deng Noodles
intro: A local Chongqing noodle (小面) shop near Shibati. Spicy, numbing and cheap.
tips: Say 微辣 (wēi là) for mild spice.
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区十八梯 邓凳面

name: Li Ban Deng Noodles
intro: Another popular Chongqing noodle (小面) shop. Pick whichever is closer when the walk ends.
tips: Say 微辣 (wēi là) for mild spice.
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区 李板凳面

name: Shibati (Eighteen Steps)
intro: A historic stairway neighborhood that once linked Chongqing's upper and lower city. It's now a restored old-town area with shops and snacks. Commercial and busy, so we just pass through.
tips: Photograph old-style roofs against skyscrapers.
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区 十八梯传统风貌区

name: Chunhong Hotpot
intro: One of three hotpot options near Jiefangbei for our first Chongqing hotpot night. Pick whichever has the shortest wait.
tips: Order a split (鸳鸯) pot if anyone wants a non-spicy side. Try beef tripe (毛肚) and duck intestine (鸭肠).
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区解放碑附近 春红火锅

name: Lianjie Hotpot
intro: One of three hotpot options near Jiefangbei. Pick whichever has the shortest wait.
tips: Order a split (鸳鸯) pot if anyone wants a non-spicy side.
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区解放碑附近 莲姐火锅

name: Dongma Hotpot
intro: One of three hotpot options near Jiefangbei. Pick whichever has the shortest wait.
tips: Order a split (鸳鸯) pot if anyone wants a non-spicy side.
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区解放碑附近 董妈火锅

name: Huangjueya Old Street
intro: A small historic street high on Nanshan, with stone lanes, traditional houses, little shops and teahouses. Quieter and more local than Shibati, and the day's highest point.
tips: Taxi UP here; don't start the Huangge trail from the bottom.
addressZh: 重庆市南岸区 黄桷垭老街

name: Huangge Ancient Trail
intro: A historic stone mountain road that linked the riverside with Nanshan. Now a shaded trail with old steps and huge Huangge trees. We walk it top to bottom.
tips: Skip Laojundong (老君洞); it adds climbing.
addressZh: 重庆市南岸区 黄葛古道

name: Longmenhao Old Street
intro: A restored hillside district on the Yangtze's south bank, with early-20th-century buildings and great views toward the Yuzhong skyline.
tips: Photograph Dongshuimen Bridge with the skyline behind it.
addressZh: 重庆市南岸区 龙门浩老街

name: Xiahaoli
intro: A revitalized hillside neighborhood of narrow lanes, stairs and old courtyards, more about atmosphere than landmarks. We find a café and stay through golden hour into blue hour.
addressZh: 重庆市南岸区 下浩里

name: Guihuo Roast Chicken & Taro Chicken
intro: A dinner option for spicy chicken with taro (芋儿鸡), a Chongqing favorite that isn't hotpot.
addressZh: 重庆市 鬼火烧鸡芋儿鸡

name: Nie Facai Jianghu Cuisine
intro: A dinner option for Jianghu cuisine (江湖菜): bold, rustic Chongqing home-style dishes.
addressZh: 重庆市 聂发财江湖菜

name: Zhazidong Prison Site
intro: A former detention site on Geleshan tied to Chongqing's wartime and revolutionary history. Not a scenic stop; the value is the history.
tips: Use the official English audio guide. Entry is free but may need a real-name reservation in advance.
addressZh: 重庆市沙坪坝区歌乐山 渣滓洞

name: Baigongguan (Bai Mansion) Prison Site
intro: Originally a private villa, later used as a detention facility. Together with Zhazidong, it gives context to the Hongyan history sites.
tips: Take the scenic-area shuttle or a taxi from Zhazidong; the terrain is hilly.
addressZh: 重庆市沙坪坝区歌乐山 白公馆

name: Liziba Monorail Viewing Platform
nameZh: 李子坝单轨穿楼观景平台
intro: The famous spot where Line 2 monorail trains pass straight through an apartment building. Watch two or three trains, take videos, move on.
tips: Navigate to the viewing platform (观景平台), not just “Liziba Station”.
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区 李子坝单轨穿楼观景平台

name: Guanyinqiao Pedestrian Street
intro: One of Chongqing's biggest modern shopping and nightlife districts, with malls, street food, lights and lots of young locals.
tips: Dinner here at Chen Pangzi Hotpot.
addressZh: 重庆市江北区 观音桥步行街

name: Chen Pangzi Hotpot
intro: Tonight's hotpot dinner in Guanyinqiao.
tips: Order a split (鸳鸯) pot if anyone wants a non-spicy side.
addressZh: 重庆市江北区观音桥 陈胖子火锅

name: Baixiangju
intro: A hillside residential complex famous for Chongqing's ‘8D’ vertical layout: different floors open onto streets at different heights. Great views of Dongshuimen Bridge and the Yangtze cableway.
tips: It's a real residential building; be respectful and don't block residents.
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区 白象居

name: Jiujiu Douhua
intro: A homestyle Chongqing restaurant for savory douhua (silky tofu) with spicy dipping sauce and rice. Very different from hotpot and noodles.
tips: Order douhua + dipping sauce (蘸水) + rice + braised pork (烧白).
addressZh: 重庆市 九九豆花馆

name: Chongqing Grand Theatre
intro: A striking modern performing-arts center at Jiangbeizui. We use it as a landmark to reach the riverfront opposite Hongyadong.
tips: Tell the taxi 重庆大剧院, NOT 洪崖洞.
addressZh: 重庆市江北区 重庆大剧院

name: Grand Theatre Riverfront / Jiangbeizui
nameZh: 大剧院江滩 · 江北嘴江边
intro: The riverside below the Grand Theatre, with the classic view of Qiansimen Bridge, Hongyadong and the Yuzhong skyline. A top scenic stop: arrive in daylight and stay through sunset into night.
addressZh: 重庆市江北区 江北嘴 重庆大剧院江边

name: Hongyadong (view only)
intro: A cliffside complex in the style of traditional stilt houses, built vertically into the hillside and dramatically lit at night. For us the outside is the attraction: we photograph it from across the river.
tips: Don't go inside; it's very crowded.
addressZh: 重庆市渝中区嘉陵江滨江路88号 洪崖洞

name: Qiansimen Bridge
intro: The cable-stayed bridge right beside Hongyadong, linking Jiangbeizui with Yuzhong. Walking across gives changing views of Hongyadong and the skyline.
tips: Optional: walk one way toward the hotel only if it isn't packed.
addressZh: 重庆市 千厮门嘉陵江大桥

name: Swissôtel Beijing Hong Kong Macau Center
intro: Our Beijing hotel.
